root_cause.text: tcf_csum_act() accesses and pulls nested VLAN headers from skb->data without first verifying (via pskb_may_pull) that the full VLAN header is linearized, enabling out-of-bounds read and skb invariant corruption.
root_cause.evidence: The CVE description states: "The current code reads vlan->h_vlan_encapsulated_proto and then pulls VLAN_HLEN bytes without first ensuring that the full VLAN header is present in the linear area." The patch adds `if (!pskb_may_pull(skb, VLAN_HLEN)) goto drop;` before accessing the VLAN header.

intent_record.intent_summary: Add pskb_may_pull check for VLAN header access in csum action to prevent out-of-bounds read.
intent_record.what: Added a pskb_may_pull(skb, VLAN_HLEN) check before accessing the VLAN header; moved the vlan pointer declaration after the check.
intent_record.how: Before dereferencing skb->data as a vlan_hdr, the code now verifies that skb has at least VLAN_HLEN bytes in its linear data area (or can be pulled). If not, it jumps to the drop label, preventing an out-of-bounds memory access.
